title: Lateral Ankle Treatment
official: Prevention of the Os Fibulare After an Acute Lateral Ankle Avulsion Fracture in Pediatric Patients: A Randomized Control Trial
summary: This is a randomized control trial of pediatric patients with acute lateral ankle avulsion fractures. Patients will be randomized into two groups: Standard of care treatment which includes booting with early range of motion and gradual weening from the boot and a Test treatment which includes a 6 week short-let cast. The purpose of the study is to test whether prolonged immobilization (casting) can help prevent the formation of a subfibular ossicle. The study consists of two patient visits.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 5-12 at time of enrollment
* Diagnosis of first-time lateral ankle injury and an avulsion fracture visible on imaging who can be enrolled within 14 days of injury
* Patient and parent/legal guardian must speak English or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous ipsilateral ankle surgery
* Pre-existing musculoskeletal disease
* If patient has been casted prior to confirmation of avulsion fracture on imaging
* Developmental delay
* Does not meet inclusion criteria
